mapper.sql: template.id, template.template_name, template.template_type, template.module_code, template.version, template.file_id, template.is_default, template.default_scope_key, template.status, template.version_no, template.created_at, template.updated_at, file.original_name AS file_name, file.content_type AS file_content_type, file.size_bytes AS file_size_bytes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_import_export_template (id, template_name, template_type, module_code, version, file_id, is_default, default_scope_key, status) VALUES (#{template.id}, #{template.templateName}, #{template.templateType}, #{template.moduleCode}, #{template.version}, #{template.fileId}, #{template.defaultTemplate}, #{template.defaultScopeKey}, #{template.status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_import_export_template template INNER JOIN sys_file file ON file.id = template.file_id WHERE template.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM sys_import_export_template template INNER JOIN sys_file file ON file.id = template.file_id WHERE template.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND template.template_type = #{templateType} AND template.is_default = 1 AND template.status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT FROM sys_import_export_template template INNER JOIN sys_file file ON file.id = template.file_id WHERE template.template_type = 'EXPORT' AND template.module_code = 'REPORT' AND template.status = 'ENABLED' AND file.status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY template.updated_at DESC, template.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT FROM sys_import_export_template template INNER JOIN sys_file file ON file.id = template.file_id WHERE template.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND template.template_type = #{templateType} ORDER BY template.id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET is_default = 0, default_scope_key = CONCAT('ID:', id), version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE module_code = #{moduleCode} AND template_type = #{templateType} AND is_default = 1

UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET is_default = 1, default_scope_key = 'DEFAULT', version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ENABLED'
UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET status = 'ENABLED', version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'DISABLED'

UPDATE sys_import_export_template SET status = 'DISABLED', is_default = 0, default_scope_key = CONCAT('ID:', id), version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ENABLED'
